articles.title: Xbox首席运营官Helen Chiang上任三个月后离职
articles.summary: 据The Verge获得的内部备忘录，Xbox首席运营官Helen Chiang在任职三个月后离开微软，职责暂由其他高管分担。
articles.new_facts: Helen Chiang在出任Xbox首任首席运营官三个月后离开微软，结束21年任职；Xbox CEO Asha Sharma内部备忘录确认，职责暂由其他高管分担，继任安排未定。
articles.limitations: 依据Gematsu转述The Verge获得内部备忘录，未直接取得微软或Xbox公开声明；离职原因未披露。

facts.text: 据The Verge获得的内部备忘录，Helen Chiang在出任Xbox首席运营官三个月后离开微软，结束21年任职。Xbox CEO Asha Sharma在备忘录中表示感谢，但未说明离职原因，Xbox传播副总裁回应称不讨论个人人事事项。

evidence.quote: Helen Chiang has left her role as Xbox chief operating officer after just three months, according to an internal memo obtained by The Verge .

facts.text: Chiang于7月被任命为Xbox首位首席运营官，负责内容、硬件、平台与服务的损益职责，此前曾领导Mojang与《我的世界》系列。其职责将暂由其他Xbox负责人分担，直至确定该职位的长期领导方案。

evidence.quote: Chiang’s immediate responsibilities will be divided among other Xbox leaders until a permanent leadership plan for the role is finalized.

bilingual.title_en: Xbox Chief Operating Officer Helen Chiang Departs Three Months After Taking Role

sentences.en: Helen Chiang left Microsoft after three months as Xbox chief operating officer, ending a 21-year tenure, according to an internal memo obtained by The Verge.
sentences.zh: 据The Verge获得的内部备忘录，Helen Chiang在出任Xbox首席运营官三个月后离开微软，结束21年任职。

sentences.en: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma expressed thanks in the memo but did not state a reason for the departure, and an Xbox communications vice president responded that the company does not discuss individual personnel matters.
sentences.zh: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma在备忘录中表示感谢，但未说明离职原因，Xbox传播副总裁回应称不讨论个人人事事项。

sentences.en: Chiang was appointed in July as Xbox's first chief operating officer, responsible for profit-and-loss duties across content, hardware, platform and services, after previously leading Mojang and the Minecraft franchise.
sentences.zh: Chiang于7月被任命为Xbox首位首席运营官，负责内容、硬件、平台与服务的损益职责，此前曾领导Mojang与《我的世界》系列。

sentences.en: Her responsibilities will temporarily be shared by other Xbox leaders until a long-term leadership plan for the position is determined.
sentences.zh: 其职责将暂由其他Xbox负责人分担，直至确定该职位的长期领导方案。
